function.name: PythonREPL
function.description:
A Python REPL. Use this to execute python code. Input should be a valid python command. If you want to see the output of a value, you should print it out with `print(...)`. You cannot use matplotlib. No plotting is allowed.
Packages you can import: np, times_days, rvs_ms, sigmas_ms, baselines, history, star_mass_sun, t_ref_days, stargazer_planet_from_fit, STARGAZER_SUBMISSION_GUIDE.

function.name: submit_action
function.description: Submit a candidate RV model to the environment. Preferred protocol: Stargazer-native planet fields (P_days, m_sin_i_mjup, e, omega_rad, l_rad). Provide up to 7 planets with P_days > 0.5 and eccentricity between 0 and 0.8. This task currently expects submission_mode='params_and_model'. The environment will evaluate your submission and return a reward with detailed metrics.

P_days.description: Stargazer planet format: orbital period in days (alternative to period_days).

m_sin_i_mjup.description: Stargazer planet format: minimum mass in Jupiter masses (optional; if provided, K is approximated assuming M_star=1Msun).

phase_deg.description: Phase in degrees (optional, provide either phase_deg or phase_rad)

phase_rad.description: Phase in radians (optional, provide either phase_deg or phase_rad)

phase.description: Phase alias (optional). Interpreted as radians if |phase|<=2π, else degrees if |phase|<=360.

phase_frac.description: Phase as fraction of an orbit in [0,1) (optional). Converted to radians via 2π*phase_frac.

l_rad.description: Stargazer planet format: mean longitude at t_ref=times_days[0] in radians.

e.description: Stargazer planet format: eccentricity (alias for eccentricity).

omega_rad.description: Stargazer planet format: argument of periapsis in radians (optional; matching uses l_rad).

inc_rad.description: Inclination in radians for REBOUND forward model (optional; default pi/2).

Omega_rad.description: Longitude of ascending node in radians for REBOUND forward model (optional; default 0).

items.description: Recommended: use Stargazer native fields (P_days, m_sin_i_mjup, e, omega_rad, l_rad). Legacy aliases are accepted.

planets.description: List of planet hypotheses, sorted by confidence (most confident first).

rv_offset_ms.description: Constant RV offset in m/s (optional, will be estimated if not provided).

noise_jitter_ms.description: Optional white-noise jitter term in m/s.

notes.description: Brief rationale for this submission (optional but recommended).
